paper_title: Robust bounds on ALP dark matter from dwarf spheroidal galaxies in the optical MUSE-Faint survey
notes: 95% C.L. combined upper limit on ALP-two-photon coupling g_agamma from radiative decay of ALP DM in five dwarf spheroidal galaxies (Leo T, Sculptor, Eridanus 2, Grus 1, Hydra II) observed with MUSE. Mass range 2.7-5.3 eV. Bound level ~1e-12 GeV^-1, improving slightly toward higher mass. Numerical values approximated from Figs. 2/5 (NFW profile); paper does not tabulate.
